> AURA — Wearable Health-Tech Pendant AURA is a jewelry-inspired wearable concept exploring physiological sensing, motion tracking, signal-quality analysis, and experimental machine learning. The design combines a compact electronics system with a premium gold pendant form, using a PPG sensor, IMU, and BLE-enabled microcontroller to collect data for a companion app. This project focuses on the system architecture, electronics integration, and industrial design
